user.title: Step 1 of 4 — Zero Home
user.description:
Zero Home links this Home Assistant to your Zero account, so Zero can control your home from anywhere — no router settings, no domain of your own, nothing to change in configuration.yaml.

You will: 1) sign in to Zero, 2) choose what Zero can see, 3) decide whether Home Assistant's own screens open from outside (off by default). Press Submit to start.

login.title: Sign in with your Zero account
login.description: Use the same username and password you sign in to Zero with. The home's address will be your username: https://<username>.home.<domain>. Your plan must include the smart home.

data_description.username: Exactly as you sign in to Zero.
data_description.admin_api: Leave as it is unless Zero support told you otherwise.

code.title: Activation code
code.description: Enter the activation code from your Zero account page (My account → Smart home → Zero Home). It looks like ZH-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, is valid for 24 hours and works once.

data_description.code: Lowercase letters and spaces are fine.
data_description.admin_api: Leave as it is unless Zero support told you otherwise.

reauth_confirm.title: Link this home again
reauth_confirm.description: Zero stopped this link (the key was replaced or revoked, or the subscription no longer includes Zero Home). Sign in again with your Zero username and password — or enter a new activation code instead.

method.title: Sign in to Zero
method.description: How do you want to link this home?

menu_options.login: With my Zero username and password (recommended)

see.title: Step 2 of 4 — What can Zero see?
see.description:
Choose which devices Zero may see and control. You can change this any time from the integration's «Configure» button.

• **Everything** — simplest, recommended.
• **Only some rooms** or **only some device types** — you pick on the next screen.

data.see: What Zero may see and control

see_rooms.title: Choose the rooms
see_rooms.description: Zero will see and control only the devices in these rooms.

see_types.title: Choose the device types
see_types.description: Zero will see and control only these kinds of devices (lights, switches, air conditioning…).

see_custom.title: Choose exactly
see_custom.description: A device is visible to Zero when it is in one of the chosen rooms, OR of one of the chosen types, OR has one of the chosen labels, OR is listed.

outside.title: Step 3 of 4 — Home Assistant's own screens from outside?
outside.description:
Zero controls your home from anywhere either way — by voice and in the Zero app.

This choice is only about opening **Home Assistant's own web interface** from outside the home at {public_url}. It stays **off** unless you turn it on, and you can change it any time. No changes to configuration.yaml are needed.

ui_not_ready.title: Zero Home: the web interface from outside is closed
ui_not_ready.description:
Through Zero Home every visitor reaches Home Assistant as if they were at home, so the web interface from outside stays closed while Home Assistant gives home-network visitors extra rights ({blocker}).

To open it: turn off «Can only log in from the local network» for those users (Settings → People), or remove the «trusted networks» login. If your Home Assistant version still accepts it, adding these lines to `configuration.yaml` also works:

```yaml
{yaml}
```

Voice control and Zero's control of your devices work without it.

link_revoked.title: Zero Home: the link was stopped
link_revoked.description: Zero no longer accepts this home's key (it was revoked or replaced by a newer activation). Open Settings → Devices & services → Zero Home and enter a new activation code from your Zero account page.

plan_ended.title: Zero Home: subscription does not include it
plan_ended.description: Your Zero subscription no longer includes Zero Home, so the link is stopped. Renew or upgrade the subscription, then enter a new activation code in Settings → Devices & services → Zero Home.

relay_unreachable.title: Zero Home: cannot reach the Zero relay
relay_unreachable.description: This Home Assistant has not been able to reach the Zero relay for more than 30 minutes (last error: {error}). Check the internet connection; the integration keeps retrying on its own.

external_url_conflict.title: Zero Home: external URL already set
external_url_conflict.description: Home Assistant's external URL is {current}, so Zero Home did not change it to {public_url}. To use the Zero Home address in the mobile apps, open the Zero Home options and confirm the replacement.
